title: LTM Model
shortDescription: A high-performance machine learning deployment interface for Long-Term Memory (LTM) models, featuring sequence inference, memory retention benchmarks, and dynamic parameter tuning.
overview: LTM Model is a dedicated web interface and API deployment for experimenting with Long-Term Memory language architectures. Designed for AI engineers and researchers, it enables users to test token context retention across extended sequence windows, visualize attention decay, calibrate temperature and top-p sampling, and benchmark inference latencies.
problem: Evaluating language models with extended context lengths typically requires running local command-line scripts or heavy notebooks that are inaccessible to non-ML teammates and stakeholders.
solution: Engineered a lightweight, responsive web interface deployed on Render that connects to model inference endpoints, streams token output, and graphs context memory retention curves in real time.

features.title: Extended Context Sequence Generation
features.description: Input long-horizon prompts and inspect model completions with highlighted token probabilities and attention weightings.

features.title: Real-Time Parameter Calibration
features.description: Interactive sliders to adjust temperature, top-k, repetition penalties, and max sequence lengths on the fly.

features.title: Memory Retention Analytics
features.description: Visual charts tracking how accurately the model recalls facts mentioned thousands of tokens earlier in the conversation.

features.title: Inference Latency Telemetry
features.description: Live metrics on time-to-first-token (TTFT), token generation throughput, and GPU/memory utilization stats.

contributions: Built the full responsive web application with dark-mode cyber styling and real-time streaming output panes.
Integrated backend API proxies that handle model inference requests and buffer incoming token streams.
Developed interactive parameter controls and visual charts for memory retention benchmarking.
Deployed and optimized the application on Render with automatic health check monitoring.

challenges.title: Handling High-Memory Model Cold Starts on Free Tiers
challenges.challenge: When hosted instances idle, initial model reload requests could trigger HTTP 504 gateway timeouts before memory buffers warm up.
challenges.solution: Implemented an exponential backoff client retry strategy with friendly visual loading states and a lightweight health-check ping on page load.

challenges.title: Rendering High-Volume Token Output Without DOM Freeze
challenges.challenge: Rapid incoming token updates caused continuous DOM reflows that degraded browser UI responsiveness during long generations.
challenges.solution: Batched incoming stream chunks into 50ms animation frame slices using `requestAnimationFrame`, preventing main thread UI blocking.
